notes.title: One year in Steam!
notes.content:
One year ago (and a couple of days) [b]ASDAD[/b] was released on [b]Steam[/b]!

Thanks for being part of this journey!

To celebrate, I'm taking the price of the game down to [b]$4.99[/b], hoping that this will make the game more accessible to new players.

More details [url=http://giantenemylabs.com/?p=1005]here[/url].

I truly appreciate the feedback I've received, and the time you've all spent with the game. It makes me happy to see new reviews (good and bad), screenshots, and people talking about [b]ASDAD[/b].

You all rock!

notes.title: ASDAD Christmas Update is finally Here!
notes.content:
[img=http://giantenemylabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/Christmas_update_tease.png][/img]
We are pretty close to [b]Christmas[/b] and I've got a little surprise for all of you guys! You should all be able to update to [b]version 3.0[/b] of the game now, which adds a [b]New Guest Character[/b] and a number of improvements to the game! (It also has a small Christmas surprise!)

For instance now there's a [b]Single Player (Practice!) Race for the Idol[/b] mode, color-coded hint ribbons in item boxes, slightly improved progress saving, reworked voice acting, etc.

You can read the full official announcement on [url=http://giantenemylabs.com/asdad-christmas-update-is-live/]our website.[/url]

Hope you all have a [b]Merry Christmas[/b] and thanks again for your support!

notes.title: Happy Halloween Everyone!
notes.content:
[img=http://giantenemylabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/haunted_graveyard_banner_wide.png][/img]
I've been preparing a surprise for this day, and it's finally [b]up and ready[/b], so you should all be able to update to [b]version 2.1[/b] of the game now! This is a small update over 2.0 that contains a [b]New Stage[/b], fittingly spooky and designed with this holiday in mind, so I hope you all enjoy it.

This update also contain some minor changes which will hopefully improve the experience a little bit. You can read the full official announcement on [url=http://giantenemylabs.com/halloween-update/]our website.[/url]

Have a [b]Happy Halloween[/b] everyone and I sincerely wish you luck with your trick-or-treating today!

notes.title: ASDAD Fundamental Secrets, Details and Facts!
notes.content:
Hi guys, I just published a sort of "advanced" guide to [b]ASDAD[/b].

It's called [b]All-Stars Dungeons and Diamonds Fundamental Secrets, Details and Facts[/b] ([b]ASDADFSDAF[/b])  and contains detailed information about every element in the game.

You can read more about it [url=http://giantenemylabs.com/asdad-fundamental-secrets-details-and-facts/]here[/url].

Or you can jump straight to it [url=http://giantenemylabs.com/download/869/]ASDAD Fundamental Secrets, Details and Facts [/url]

Thanks again guys for your support and I hope you are all enjoying [b]ASDAD[/b]!
